description: Adversarially reviewed Universal Coding Memory Optimization for the ChronodeAi Agentmemory fork
guidance: Force codebase-analysis despite existing framework configuration. Preserve source and tests; create planning/governance artifacts only. Treat the lifecycle as Recall -> Verify -> Explore -> Act -> Test -> Record -> Promote -> Commit -> Close. Git, live source, tests, accepted ADRs, and runtime evidence are authoritative; Codebase Memory is structural navigation and Agentmemory is project-scoped episodic/procedural recall, never proof. Cover canonical identity, migration, fail-closed scope, slots, all project-filtered interfaces, dedupe, sessions, capture/redaction/exclusions, compaction and exact facts, eligibility-first <=2000-token packets, acknowledged delivery, temporal and committed/uncommitted provenance, commit linkage, health, evidence-gated promotion, no self-reinforcement, explicit-only native synchronization, strict local privacy, secret-file authentication, Codex/Claude integration, hooks/backpressure, fail-closed MCP, sustained health, slots, and viewer/backend build identity. Treat AIWG distribution and Codebase Memory 0.9.1 migration as external; do not edit other repositories or access Memetics. Use reported Memetics failures as adversarial evidence, keep Memetics recall explicit-only, and block automatic gate-critical injection. Require unit/integration, labelled retrieval/answer quality, stale-authority, collisions, secrets, concurrent load, soak, rollback, and five-session canary evidence. Do not auto-approve, baseline, waive, or authorize Construction; use CONDITIONAL with exact owners and conclude NOT CONSTRUCTION READY.
